weaknesses.evidence: Monsoon flooding is an operational risk that affects cost, safety and compliance simultaneously. In Mumbai and Chennai, low-lying arterial stretches can close for hours; in Bengaluru, overflowing underpasses create sudden detours that, for example, add 30–60 minutes to routes. A single waterlogged stretch can cause whole shuttle runs to be cancelled, increasing payroll costs from paid but idle hours; reduce headcount available for morning shifts, affecting service delivery in BPO/GCC sites; and raise safety and legal exposure when employees, especially women or night-shift staff, are forced to wait at unsheltered pickup points.
